program:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,csv,xlrd,math
ROOT=Path.cwd();R29="reports/research/510300_bank_industry_constraint_source_probe_v1"
R30="reports/research/510300_bank_current_vintage_ratio_cause_identity_v1";OUT=ROOT/R30
assert not OUT.exists(),"已注册，不重复计算"
proposal=json.loads((ROOT/R29/"next_experiment.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert proposal["experiment_id"]=="E30" and proposal["primary_pairs"]==["2025Q1→Q2","2025Q2→Q3"]
source=ROOT/R29/"9a20b3d34d24444bbdd77a210675a95c.xls"
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def stamp():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def save(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists()
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
OUT.mkdir()
parents=[R29+"/next_experiment.json",R29+"/protocol.json",R29+"/result.json",R29+"/发布正文与年度滚动表时钟.json",R29+"/9a20b3d34d24444bbdd77a210675a95c.xls"]
protocol={"study_id":"510300_BANK_CURRENT_VINTAGE_RATIO_CAUSE_IDENTITY_V1","experiment_id":"E30","registered_at":stamp(),
"question":proposal["question"],"pairs":proposal["primary_pairs"],"source_vintage":"2026-02-12 current attachment",
"ratio_definitions":{"资本充足率":"资本净额/应用资本底线后的风险加权资产合计","不良贷款率":"不良贷款余额/(正常类贷款+关注类贷款+不良贷款余额)"},
"fixed_order":"分子先、分母后：新分子/旧分母-旧分子/旧分母；新分子/新分母-新分子/旧分母。",
"units":"源金额为亿元；原比率单元格为比例；报告贡献转换为百分点。",
"necessary_admission":"金额派生比率在原显示值舍入区间内；所有金额有限/同表/分母正，恒等分解误差<=1e-12。",
"rounding_tolerance_rule":"取原Excel百分比显示小数位，半个末位的比例幅度；不以结果调容忍。另保存与原未格式化数值的残差。",
"source_historical_admission":False,"operating_cause_identification":False,
"parents":[{"path":p,"sha256":sha(ROOT/p)} for p in parents],
"new_source_requests":0,"new_fits":0,"new_training_labels":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,
"orders_authorized":False,"new_prospective_forecasts_enabled":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","goal_achieved":False}
save("protocol.json",protocol)
book=xlrd.open_workbook(str(source),formatting_info=True);sheet=book.sheet_by_name("商业银行季度")
rowmap={str(sheet.cell_value(i,0)).strip():i for i in range(sheet.nrows)}
def val(name,c):return float(sheet.cell_value(rowmap[name],c))
def cell(name,c):return chr(65+c)+str(rowmap[name]+1)
inputs=[]
for c in [1,2,3]:
 cap=val("资本净额",c);rwa=val("应用资本底线后的风险加权资产合计",c)
 npl=val("不良贷款余额",c);normal=val("正常类贷款",c);watch=val("关注类贷款",c)
 for name,n,d in [("资本充足率",cap,rwa),("不良贷款率",npl,normal+watch+npl)]:
  reported=val(name,c)
  xf=book.xf_list[sheet.cell_xf_index(rowmap[name],c)]
  fmt=book.format_map[xf.format_key].format_str
  assert fmt=="0.00%","显示精度与冻结规则不符："+fmt
  tolerance=0.5*10**(-2)/100
  assert d>0 and all(math.isfinite(v) for v in [n,d,reported])
  derived=n/d;residual=derived-reported
  assert abs(residual)<=tolerance,"同表金额与原比率显示精度不一致："+name
  inputs.append({"quarter":"2025Q"+str(c),"ratio":name,"numerator":n,"denominator":d,"reported_ratio":reported,"derived_ratio":derived,
  "raw_ratio_residual":residual,"display_half_step_tolerance":tolerance,"ratio_cell":cell(name,c),"excel_number_format":fmt,
  "amount_unit":"亿元","source_vintage":"2026-02-12","historical_original_known_value_admitted":False})
save("全部三个季度_同表比率金额及舍入残差.json",inputs)
records=[]
for ratio in ["资本充足率","不良贷款率"]:
 pool=[x for x in inputs if x["ratio"]==ratio]
 for before,after in zip(pool,pool[1:]):
  n0,d0=before["numerator"],before["denominator"];n1,d1=after["numerator"],after["denominator"]
  numerator=(n1-n0)/d0
  denominator=n1/d1-n1/d0
  total=n1/d1-n0/d0
  assert abs(numerator+denominator-total)<=1e-12
  records.append({"ratio":ratio,"from_quarter":before["quarter"],"to_quarter":after["quarter"],
  "numerator_old":n0,"numerator_new":n1,"numerator_change":n1-n0,"numerator_change_fraction":n1/n0-1,
  "denominator_old":d0,"denominator_new":d1,"denominator_change":d1-d0,"denominator_change_fraction":d1/d0-1,
  "reported_ratio_change_pp":100*(after["reported_ratio"]-before["reported_ratio"]),
  "derived_ratio_change_pp":100*total,"numerator_first_contribution_pp":100*numerator,"denominator_second_contribution_pp":100*denominator,
  "reported_vs_derived_change_residual_pp":100*(after["reported_ratio"]-before["reported_ratio"]-total),
  "identity_error":numerator+denominator-total,"arithmetic_order":"分子先，分母后","causal_share":False})
save("全部四组_分子分母固定顺序贡献.json",records)
with (OUT/"两个区间两指标_完整构成.csv").open("w",encoding="utf-8-sig",newline="") as f:
 writer=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(records[0]));writer.writeheader();writer.writerows(records)
for p in protocol["parents"]:assert sha(ROOT/p["path"])==p["sha256"]
completed=stamp()
result={"study_id":protocol["study_id"],"experiment_id":"E30","completed_at":completed,
"status":"COMPLETED_SAME_VINTAGE_BANK_RATIO_NUMERATOR_DENOMINATOR_IDENTITIES",
"classification":"PROGRESS_E29_SOURCE_BREAKS_AND_E30_TWO_FIXED_QUARTER_CAUSE_IDENTITIES_COMPLETED",
"quarters":3,"ratios":2,"pair_results":4,"records":records,
"max_absolute_raw_ratio_residual":max(abs(x["raw_ratio_residual"]) for x in inputs),
"source_vintage":"2026-02-12","source_original_quarter_known_clock_admitted":False,
"bank_operating_behavior_cause_identified":False,"index_return_increment_established":False,
"new_source_requests":0,"new_fits":0,"new_training_labels":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,
"net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_achieved":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET",
"orders_authorized":False,"new_prospective_forecasts_enabled":False,"independent_validation":"NOT_ESTABLISHED_ALREADY_OBSERVED_HISTORY",
"facts_report":R30+"/资本率与不良率为什么变化_同版本研究结论.md"}
save("result.json",result)
lines=["# 银行业资本率与不良率：两区间的同版本金额构成","",
"只使用2026-02-12当前官方2025年度表的前三季度。以下是同一版本的金额/比率恒等分解，不是原季度当时可知输入、经营行为因果份额或指数方向预测。固定先分子后分母，保留全部两相邻区间；四季度不计算。","",
"| 指标/区间 | 原比率变化(百分点) | 由金额派生变化 | 分子先贡献 | 分母后贡献 |","|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|"]
for x in records:lines.append(f'| {x["ratio"]} {x["from_quarter"]}→{x["to_quarter"]} | {x["reported_ratio_change_pp"]:+.6f} | {x["derived_ratio_change_pp"]:+.6f} | {x["numerator_first_contribution_pp"]:+.6f} | {x["denominator_second_contribution_pp"]:+.6f} |')
lines+=["",
"资本充足率的分子为资本净额，分母为应用资本底线后的风险加权资产。不良率的分子为不良余额，分母由正常、关注、不良三类余额相加。原显示为0.00%，派生与原比率残差都在冻结的显示舍入区间；未把额外内部小数当作历史市场知道的精度。",
"",
"Q2→Q3资本净额仍增加，资本比率下降对应风险加权资产增幅更大；不能把下降全部称资本损失。同期不良余额上升，贷款总额也上升；分母扩张抵消部分不良率上升，不能把上升解释成贷款总量缩减。Q1→Q2的方向和抵消关系另列，不能由一个区间推广成固定指数规律。",
"",
"金额恒等式不能进一步识别利润留存、资本发行、扣除项目、贷款核销、转让/重分类或真实借款人恶化的贡献；这些上游原因仍未知。净息差计算期间尚未建立，不作差分。行业汇总也不代表沪深300金融权重。",
"",
"新源/拟合/训练标签/账户/源码均0；夏普NOT_COMPUTED，完整目标未达。E29的原版本/统计断点与E26/E27/E28裁决保持。",
"",
"证据：[协议](protocol.json)、[三个季度输入与舍入](全部三个季度_同表比率金额及舍入残差.json)、[完整四组贡献](全部四组_分子分母固定顺序贡献.json)、[结果](result.json)、[官方当前年度表](https://www.nfra.gov.cn/cn/view/pages/ItemDetail.html?docId=1208453&itemId=954&generaltype=0)。"]
(OUT/"资本率与不良率为什么变化_同版本研究结论.md").write_text("\n".join(lines)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
save("保存结果必要核对.json",{"status":"PASS_ALL_FIXED_QUARTER_RATIO_IDENTITIES_AND_DISPLAY_PRECISION",
"rows":6,"pair_results":4,"all_fixed_pairs_retained":True,"all_source_parents_unchanged":True,
"original_quarter_pit_admission_claimed":False,"new_accounts":0,"new_fits":0,"source_code_edits":0})
follow=ROOT/R29/"next_experiment_execution_followup.json"
assert not follow.exists()
follow.write_text(json.dumps({"original_frozen_E30_proposal_unchanged":True,"actual_protocol":R30+"/protocol.json","result":R30+"/result.json","status":result["status"]},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"E30":result["status"],"四组完整构成":records,"拟合":0,"原历史准入":False,"目标":False},ensure_ascii=False))
